video_summary.overall_goal: Create a new baker's percentage recipe and save it
video_summary.description: User creates new recipe with name 'cake', ingredient (Flour at 100%), notes, and oven temperature, then saves successfully

visible_ui_elements: text: Press the + button to add your first recipe!

visible_ui_elements: section: Ingredients with Ingredient Name and % fields
steps.system_response: Text 'cake' entered in Recipe Name field

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Recipe form with 'cake' in Recipe Name, Unit dropdown set to grams
steps.system_response: Form displays with default ingredient 'Flour' at 100%

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Recipe form with focus on Notes field
steps.system_response: Notes field focused and keyboard appears
steps.visual_feedback: Notes field border highlights, keyboard opens
steps.intent_task: Focus on Notes field to enter additional information

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Recipe form with Notes field filled with 'nuts'
Recipe form with focus on Oven Temp & Time field
steps.system_response: Oven Temp field focused and keyboard appears
steps.visual_feedback: Oven Temp field border highlights, keyboard opens

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Recipe form with Oven Temp & Time field showing '4'
steps.system_response: Text '4' entered in Oven Temp field
steps.visual_feedback: Text appears in Oven Temp field, keyboard suggests '4' as autocomplete

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Completed recipe form ready for save
steps.system_response: Recipe saved successfully, form closes, returns to home
steps.visual_feedback: Form closes with transition animation, home screen appears
steps.intent_task: Save the recipe and return to home

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Home screen showing saved recipe 'cake' in list with share and delete icons
visible_ui_elements: recipe card: cake (with share icon and delete icon)
steps.system_response: Recipe saved and displayed in home list
steps.visual_feedback: Recipe card appears with 'cake' label, success indicated by saved state

overall_flow: Recipe saved and appears on home screen
human_readable_step_summary: Home screen displays empty recipe list with + button
User taps + button to create new recipe
Recipe form opens with fields for name, unit, ingredients, notes, and oven temp
Form shows unit as 'grams' with auto-filled ingredient Flour at 100%
User taps Notes field and enters 'nuts'
User taps Oven Temp field and enters '4'
User taps Save Recipe button to submit form
Recipe successfully saved, home screen now displays 'cake' recipe in list
